network: ctx.serve() is api.fastly.com and the Fiddle sandbox fiddle.fastly.dev (cert/lib/stub.mjs) and logs every request; accounts.fastly.com answers 500 and api.github.com and developer.fastly.com offer a newer CLI, so a build that asks them shows it
checklist: as cone (addUser, users enforce): fastly version → Fastly CLI version v<recipe.yaml version> (<first 7 of source.commit>), built with go … wasip1/wasm, read from recipe.yaml by cert/lib/version.mjs; fastly --help lists the commands; neither makes a request (checklist.mjs)

FASTLY_API_TOKEN: fastly service list --json sends one GET https://api.fastly.com/service with Fastly-Key: <token> and a FastlyCLI/v<recipe.yaml version>, FastlyGo/ User-Agent, and prints the service; no OpenID Connect metadata fetch before it, no update check after it (checklist.mjs)
fastly service create --name --type sends one POST /service with the form body and prints the new service id; a refused token exits 1 after one request (checklist.mjs)

fastly auth add stores the token in ~/.config/fastly/config.toml, 0600 in a 0700 directory owned by the user; another user's cat of it fails; the next command sends the stored token without the 'Unprotected configuration file' warning; errors.log (it records --token) is 0600; fastly auth login takes a piped token; XDG_CONFIG_HOME moves the directory (config.mjs)

compute build, publish, hash-files, serve, init, install-tools, vcl serve, update, install and SSO (auth login --sso, profile create --sso) exit 1 with their reason and make no request; no build-data notice; compute build --help still works (unavailable.mjs)

FASTLY_API_TOKEN set: fastly vcl check recv.vcl sends one POST https://fiddle.fastly.dev/fiddle with the VCL, the default origin and the User-Agent FastlyCLI/v<recipe.yaml version>, and no Fastly-Key or Authorization; ~/.config/fastly/vcl-sandbox.json (in the 0700 directory) keeps only the sandbox id, so the next check is one PUT /fiddle/<id>; a compile error prints file:line: level: message and exits 1; fastly vcl run sends PUT /fiddle/<id>, POST /fiddle/<id>/execute and GET /results/<session>/stream, all without a token, prints the response and keeps the cache bucket (vcl.mjs)
without the host module, fastly version still runs and fastly service list reports that the runtime cannot open a connection, with no request (z-missing-host.mjs)

test/e2e/fastly.test.mjs (Node entry, slicc-kernel 1.189.2, a recording transport): the same API call on the sync and the async (Dynamic Worker) process host, config modes, a piped auth login, the refused commands, the missing host module; test/fastly-host.test.mjs: the host module's operations

patches.0001-wasip1-build.patch: every spec: without it go-ps and otiai10/copy do not compile for wasip1 and there is no fastly.wasm (cert/NEGATIVE.md).
patches.0002-wasip1-slicc-host.patch: the API calls in checklist.mjs and config.mjs (HTTP through fastly_host, go-fastly's client on http.DefaultTransport), the modes and the other user's refused read in config.mjs, the piped auth login in config.mjs, the missing-host error in z-missing-host.mjs, the sandbox calls in vcl.mjs. Built without it, service list fails at DNS and config.toml is 0644 (cert/NEGATIVE.md).
patches.0003-wasip1-unavailable-commands.patch: unavailable.mjs (every refusal and its reason, no request, no build-data notice) and the no-update-check assertions in checklist.mjs. Built without it, the update check asks developer.fastly.com after each command, compute serve tries to build and vcl serve publishes the VCL to fiddle.fastly.dev (cert/NEGATIVE.md).
patches.0004-lazy-oidc-metadata.patch: the one-request assertions in checklist.mjs and config.mjs. Built without it, service list first asks accounts.fastly.com for its OpenID Connect metadata and, with that answered 500, fails 'failed to configure authentication processes' (cert/NEGATIVE.md).
